mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) may reduce renal perfusion and inhibit prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation, potentially impairing the renal excretion of dorzolamide and increasing systemic carbonic anhydrase inhibitor effects.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes during concurrent use; consider alternative analgesic if renal impairment develops; assess for dorzolamide adverse effects including metabolic acidosis.
